text:
While on holiday in Chiang mai, I visited this clinic earlier today for a dental cleaning and polish. I was impressed by how quickly everything was arranged, I contacted the clinic and had an appointment within just thirty minutes.

From the moment I arrived, both the reception team and dental staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly. The gentleman who carried out my cleaning was especially kind, putting me completely at ease with his gentle approach and polite manner.

Although I had only booked a routine cleaning, he took the time to explain what he observed about my teeth and shared his professional thoughts on any potential issues.

I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking excellent care and a positive experience. Thank you to the staff for being so lovely 😀
